blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

South Marine is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 127 homes sold there: 110 condos and 16 townhomes. 110 condos sold in South Marine with a median price of $627,500 (the middle half sold between $528,500 and $746,250), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 3% sold above list.
South Marine home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

110 condos sold in South Marine with a median price of $627,500 (the middle half sold between $528,500 and $746,250), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $822 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median strata fee of $575 a month. 16 townhomes sold in South Marine with a median price of $943,750 (the middle half sold between $783,500 and $1,008,250), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 96.2% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $644 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $565 a month.

items.t: The City's East Fraserlands Policy Statement places that site in the southeast corner of the city on the Fraser River, between Kerr Street and Boundary Road and south of Marine Way, within the Victoria-Fraserview/Killarney community.
East Fraser Lands is guided by an Official Development Plan (2006, amended 2017) with separate rezoning policy for Area 1, Area 2 and the Kerr Street properties.
The 2004 policy statement set a target maximum of 10,000 residents on about 126 acres.
Former RS-zoned lots elsewhere became R1-1 on October 17, 2023, allowing multiplexes of 3 to 6 strata or up to 8 rental units.

blocks.text: South Marine: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The policy statement proposes a continuous riverfront path from Kerr Street Pier to Burnaby's Foreshore Path and names Everett Crowley Park (99 acres) as nearby.
Killarney Community Centre is listed at 6260 Killarney Street.

blocks.text: South Marine: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The Fraser River floodplain is the area most vulnerable to flooding in Vancouver, running from Boundary Road to Musqueam, and is largely non-diked.
The City's flood assessment describes flood protection near East Fraser Lands as rock revetments and retaining walls, and notes increasing higher-density residential there.
In 2014 the City adopted a Flood Construction Level for the floodplain with a sea level rise allowance.
The Province told municipalities in 2011 to plan for about 1 m of sea level rise by 2100.
Some residents questioned continued floodplain development such as East Fraser Lands.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did condos in South Marine sell for?
faq.a: 110 condos sold in South Marine between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $627,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in South Marine?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in South Marine sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 110 condos that sold in South Marine went for between $528,500 and $746,250, around a median of $627,500.

faq.q: Do condos in South Marine sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 110 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in South Marine?
faq.a: Of the 110 sales, 110 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $575.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in South Marine?
faq.a: The median year built was 2018 for the 110 condos sold in South Marine.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in South Marine usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in South Marine had 2 bedrooms, from the 110 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
